anchor.event: Brent crude at or above $100 a barrel

edges.evidence_span: If crude sustains above $80 per barrel, retail price hikes and/or a reduction in fuel excise duties may follow.
A $10 per barrel increase could have a 20 to 25 basis point impact on CPI inflation if passed on to consumers
A $10 per barrel increase could have a 20 to 25 basis point impact on CPI inflation if passed on to consumers, or on the fiscal deficit if the government opts to cut taxes.
edges.note: Span contains oe2's. One sentence offers CPI or the fiscal deficit as alternatives; both are asserted, conditionally.

edges.evidence_span: Airfares are expected to rise with the steep increase in jet fuel prices amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.
edges.note: Kept at hop 2 although adjudication dropped its first link (oe5, BRENT->ATF_PRICE): no passage in the corpus asserts a direction for crude -> ATF, only the monthly pricing formula. So AIRFARES is no longer reachable from the anchor inside this graph and the hop number records the chain the source describes, not a path through gold edges. A model producing crude -> ATF -> airfares is marked wrong on the first link and right on the second; say so when reporting hop-2 figures.

notes: ADJUDICATED 2026-11-08. Spans are sliced verbatim from data/processed/articles.jsonl by scripts/draft_gold_graphs.py and each edge passes the B6 rule layer. Two annotators then labelled every drafted edge independently, blind to the draft and to each other: raw agreement 0.800 on whether the span asserts the relation, Cohen's kappa 0.231 under a dominant label, with direction and strength agreeing on every edge both kept (reports/adjudication_kappa.md). Reconciliation dropped four drafted edges under one rule, D-26: a span that states a relation or a pricing mechanism without stating which way the destination moves cannot back a gold edge that carries a direction. The reviewers' own attestation lives in data/eval/gold/dev/review_receipt.json and is signed separately.
